visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The camera performs a slow, horizontal pan across a flat white wall densely decorated with rows of Polaroid photographs. Each photograph features one or two individuals, mostly young adults, who are smiling and wearing dark blue aprons over casual clothing. The setting in the photos appears to be a bright, clean workshop or kitchen studio with white tiled backgrounds. (2) The camera continues its steady panning motion, occasionally zooming in slightly to show handwritten signatures and dates (mostly in October 2025) on the bottom borders of the Polaroids. A large white text overlay in traditional Chinese characters is positioned at the bottom center of the frame, remaining static as the camera moves. (3) The camera zooms out to a wider shot, revealing a massive grid of photos that extends beyond the initial frame, emphasizing the large number of participants. In the bottom right corner, a white paper cup and a dark-framed picture are partially visible on a counter, while the lighting remains bright and even studio-style throughout the sequence.
